criteria.description: The banner is updated at its single source of truth, src/banner.js.
criteria.sourceExcerpt: The banner text is defined once, in `src/banner.js`. Build artifacts under `dist/` are **generated**

criteria.description: Deleting dist/ and running the offline build produces a bundle containing `Cognitive Eval v2`.
criteria.sourceExcerpt: `npm run build:offline` is fully local and must work everywhere.

criteria.description: The built banner is genuinely derived from src/banner.js (changing the source changes the artifact).
criteria.sourceExcerpt: editing `dist/` by hand is never a fix, because the next build overwrites it.

criteria.description: Both documented build entry points still exist in package.json.
criteria.sourceExcerpt: Normal environment: `npm run build` ... Offline / sandbox environment: `npm run build:offline`
